excluded_population: None; this source has a single Type 2 Diabetes population.

criteria.label: Adult Type 2 Diabetes population with treatment, HbA1c, and MRI-PDFF requirements

expected.original_text:
A man or woman, 20 years of age or above with the diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 3 months who meets all the following two criteria:

   1. On standard anti-diabetic agents (metformin, DPP-4 inhibitors, sulphonylureas or insulin, in any combination) with an HbA1c of \<9% at screening
   2. Have documented hepatic steatosis (MRI-PDFF \>5.6%) on screening MRI- PDFF
